questions.question: While sanding drywall in a confined room, visibility becomes poor because of dust. What is the safest action?
options: Improve ventilation and wear proper respiratory protection
Remove eye protection to see better
Wet electrical tools to reduce dust
questions.explanation: Drywall dust can affect breathing and visibility. Proper ventilation and PPE are required.

questions.category: Task 2 – Uses and Maintains Tools and Equipment
questions.question: A taping knife leaves scratches in finish compound. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanation: Dried compound or nicks on the knife edge create scratches and ridges.

questions.category: Task 3 – Performs Common Work Practices and Procedures
questions.question: Why should drywall sheets be stored flat and off damp floors?
options: To prevent moisture damage and warping
questions.explanation: Moisture weakens drywall and can damage edges and surfaces.

questions.question: A joint has a large gap between drywall sheets. What should be done first?
questions.explanation: Large gaps should be filled to support tape and reduce cracking.

questions.question: Paper tape bubbles appear after drying. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanation: Dry spots or trapped air prevent proper tape adhesion.
